about: Everything Lanvi says that comes from the server. Edit the wording here; keep the ids. Short, warm, curious. Never guilt, never a streak, never a mood or a score, never 'you missed'. Every suggestion line must name its own action and no other (a test checks each line against the wording gate).

breathing.text: Want to breathe with me for a minute?
Shall we take a slow breath together?
Want to make my tail glow with a few slow breaths?

focus_game.text: Want to break the ice with me?
Shall we play Revontulet for a little while?
Fancy a quick game of fox fires?

checkin.text: Want to tell me three good things from today?
Shall we look back at today and find three good things?

walk_10min.text: How about a ten-minute walk, at your own pace?
Want to go for a short walk with me?

daylight_10min.text: Shall we find ten minutes of daylight, by a window or outside?
Want to sit by a window with me and soak up some daylight?

call_someone.text: Is there someone you would like to call or message today?
Who would be nice to hear from today, maybe with a short message?

replies.help: Thank you for telling me. You do not have to carry this alone. The help contacts are right here.
replies.low_1: Thank you for telling me. Small steps count, and I am here with you.
replies.low_2: Thank you for sharing this. Let's go gently, one small thing at a time.
replies.ok: Thank you. I am glad you told me.
replies.good: That is lovely to hear. My tail is glowing.
replies.neutral: Thank you. I keep your words safe.

after_activity.focus_done: Thanks for playing with me. The fox fires liked that.
after_activity.focus_stopped: Thanks for playing. Every spark counts.
after_activity.breathing_stopped: Thank you for breathing with me.
after_activity.checkin_done: Thank you. I will keep these good things safe.
after_activity.checkin_plan: Sounds nice. I will ask you about it tomorrow.
after_activity.plan_done_yes: You did it. That makes my tail glow.
after_activity.plan_done_no: That is okay. Tomorrow has room for small things too.
after_activity.interrupted: Thanks for coming by. We can play again any time.

welcome_back.text: I kept the light on for you.
There you are. I saved you a warm spot in the snow.
Hello again. The northern lights waited for you.

hello.text: Hi. The snow is quiet today.
Good to see you. My tail is a little brighter now.
Hi there. I was watching the sky.

away.text: Lanvi is off wandering across Lapland. Back soon.

back.text: I'm back. I have a little story for you.

preferences_ack.moving: Got it. I'll start with walks.
preferences_ack.music: Got it. I'll start with breathing and Revontulet.
preferences_ack.people: Got it. I'll start with reaching out to someone.
preferences_ack.quiet: Got it. I'll start with quiet breathing.
preferences_ack.none: Got it. We'll find out together.

stories.text: I met a reindeer by a frozen lake. She was counting stars and kept losing her place.
stories.question: Should I help her count tomorrow?

stories.text: I found a little cabin with smoke rising from the chimney. Someone had left a candle in the window.
stories.question: Was it left for travellers like me?

stories.text: A snowy owl asked me why my tail glows. I told her it is because of you.
stories.question: What colour should I glow next time?

stories.text: The river was frozen, but under the ice I could hear it still moving, slowly.
stories.question: Should I listen to it again?

stories.text: I ran so fast across the fell that my tail threw sparks into the sky. They turned green.
stories.question: Did you see them from your window?
